evidence_class: sanitized recording of a live run
origin: SANITIZED REAL LIVE RECORDING (not synthetic): standard output, the native session file, the OTel file export and the usage report of one live launch (copilot-otel-1)

cli.name: GitHub Copilot CLI
cli.version_basis: copilot --version before and after the run (cli-version-before.txt, cli-version-after.txt)

launch: copilot -p <task> --output-format json --stream on --no-auto-update --no-ask-user --session-id <id> --disable-builtin-mcps --additional-mcp-config <journal_echo> --allow-tool read shell(ls:*) journal_echo --deny-tool write --log-dir <dir> --usage-output-file <file>, COPILOT_OTEL_FILE_EXPORTER_PATH=<otel.jsonl> with content capture on
scenario: read notes.txt, run ls -1, call journal_echo echo_record twice (alpha 1, beta 2) and always_fails once, answer in one line
sanitization: UUIDs (session, event, parent, interaction, request ids) -> deterministic stand-ins by first occurrence, the session id -> 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000c1
MCP server names the account configures other than journal_echo -> configured-server-N
opaque provider response and request ids (apiCallId, model_call_id, gen_ai.response.id and their copies) -> opaque-NNNN
system.message data.content -> labelled placeholder (private provider context; length and sha256 in provenance)
gen_ai.system_instructions -> labelled placeholder (private provider context; length and sha256 in provenance)
gen_ai.tool.definitions: built-in tools keep their names with a placeholder description and empty parameters; the journal_echo MCP tools are kept whole
the configured MCP server names of the account -> ["journal_echo"] (the run used only journal_echo)
process log reduced to the runtime line and the MCP client initialization line

process-log.txt.note: the CLI's own log (--log-dir); private steward evidence, not committed: it states the negotiated MCP protocol revision 2025-11-25 in an rmcp line; not an assembly input of this profile

original.excerpt: only the runtime line and the MCP client initialization line (which states the negotiated protocol revision); the full log stays private evidence

live_process.meaning: the CLI process outcome the run script recorded (process.json); distinct from storage finalization and acquisition extent
